title: M32 — Shared preparation tickets, offline taps and private realtime

pages.note: Actual domain orders, staff PIN session, PostgreSQL roles, private WebSocket relay, scoped HTTP reads and preparation receipts. Synthetic identities only. The supplied 65:1843 and 107:1222 frames guide the ticket grid, large phone controls and status words. Translations, batches and pack checkboxes are not fabricated. The device bezel, current clock and literal fixture data differ; pixel differences are informational. Alarm/push and expired-session review remain unfinished.
